C0571.title: Supermarket Delivery Driver Exploited Platform Loophole with 30,000+ Phone Numbers to Scam $73K in New-User Promotions
C0571.summary: A supermarket delivery driver exploited a platform vulnerability by using over 30,000 virtual phone numbers to mass-register fake new-user accounts, fraudulently obtaining merchant coupons and delivery fees, resulting in illicit gains exceeding 730,000 yuan. The scheme involved large-scale abuse of new-user incentives through fabricated identities, causing significant financial losses to the merch

references.title: Supermarket delivery driver exploited loophole with over 30,000 phone numbers, scammed 730,000 yuan through new-user benefits
